caption: Prinsengracht, Amsterdam
composition: Jordaan bridge looking along Prinsengracht toward the Westerkerk · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From a bridge in the Jordaan the Prinsengracht runs between narrow brick gabled houses, with trees and small boats along the quays. The Westerkerk tower and its crown spire close the view. It is clear, about 20.7°C, and the low western sun warms the brick and the water. Shopfront lettering is not treated as real signage.
